component.name: LAN Scan
component.summary: See the devices on your networks

description.p: LAN Scan shows every device on the networks this computer is connected to, in a list grouped by network and on a map where the distance to a device shows its ping time.

ul.li: Finds devices with nmap, ping, mDNS and UPnP
Identifies vendor, model, type and operating system
Port scans with links to web interfaces
Remembers devices and flags new ones
Handles several networks: LAN, WireGuard, Docker
Wi-Fi networks in range, and the devices on them
